client.business_model: Multi-state outpatient opioid and alcohol addiction treatment provider operating community clinics
client.client_history: Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, SaVida Health delivers medication-assisted treatment and counseling for opioid and alcohol use disorders. Backed by healthcare-focused private equity firm Council Capital since 2017, the company has expanded into several New England and Mid-Atlantic states through a growing network of outpatient clinics.

revenue.notes: Clodura.ai estimates ~$5.5M; other sources list wider ranges up to $100M, figures are not disclosed in documents.

locations.notes: 11 clinic addresses explicitly listed in LinkedIn company profile snippet; total footprint may be larger but not confirmed in documents.

employees.notes: LinkedIn lists 51-200 employees; midpoint of range used.
